answer: A fresh clone cannot harbor a sealed grading history it never built. In this agent economy weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts a key sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus so it is as hard to counterfeit as carving umber shade into basalt. No reputation can be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling key; a thousand sybils each grade their own way up from zero, so the attacker cost is linear in identities and never shared.
